question: With source-validated full-comms single-robot test_id='0001', does original M-TARE exactly reproduce equal-seed sensor/pose/waypoint prefixes while different seeds change the observed sequence?
method: Run tunnel serially with Gazebo/planner seeds 11,11,23, fixed test_id='0001', 60 simulation seconds each; retain common ROS topics and compare 100 synchronized frames plus 20 waypoints per trial.
baseline: seed11_a is exact reference for seed11_b; seed23 is variation control. No tolerance/fallback; V1/V2/V3 remain immutable FAIL.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable V4 kTestID-only run; tunnel, seeds 11/11/23, 60 seconds each, 300 frames, 60 waypoints; zero inference/training/comparison/C09/C10.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: After the complete source contract, V4 implementation, 19/19 tests, scope, cost and evidence were shown, the user replied '批准'.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly three 60-second tunnel trials use test_id='0001' and Gazebo/planner seeds 11/11/23.
All required topics are present, type-correct and nonempty; each trial has at least 100 synchronized frames and 20 finite waypoints.
Seed-11 frame rows and waypoints exactly match; seed23 changes the observed frame sequence.
V4-specific PASS/FAIL labels and zero data/model/training/C09/C10 activity.
stop_conditions: Any drift, startup/timeout/incomplete bag, topic/count/nonfinite failure, same-seed mismatch or absent different-seed change; no retry.
expected_evidence: Three bags/summaries, 300 frame identities, 60 waypoints, comparison, raw logs, frozen inputs, V4 RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU plus Gazebo; 180 simulation seconds; zero GPU/training/model inference.
